content:
Before you start

You will need your company email address and the phone you use for MFA.

  1. Open the Cisco AnyConnect client.
  2. Enter vpn.example.com and select Connect.
  3. Approve the Duo prompt on your phone.

If the profile is missing, re-import the XML file from the IT portal.
changeNote: Added screenshots and the escalation path

content:
Add the mailbox

In Outlook on the web, right-click your name and choose Add shared folder. Enter the mailbox address and select Add.

To send as the mailbox, use the From dropdown when composing.

content:
What you can do yourself

Files deleted in the last 30 days can be restored from the recycle bin in your file browser.

When to ask us

Anything older, or a whole folder that has gone missing — raise a ticket and we will restore it from the nightly backup.

Do not click

Do not open attachments or follow links. Report the message using the Report Phishing button.

Our team reviews every report and will get back to you if action is needed on your account.
